about.title: introduction
about.intro: Build a Music Player application  using Vue, Pinia, Vue Router, Composition API, Firebase, Vitest, more.
about.es6_desc: Using the latest ES6/ES7/ES8/ES9/ES10/ES11 JavaScript to write clean code.
about.vue3_desc: including Composition API, Pinia, Vue Router.
about.testing_desc: Test a project with Vitest. Unit testing allows us to test a feature in isolation.
about.pwa_desc: Converting apps to Progressive Web Apps, Support offline access, installation to local and other functions.
about.inter_desc: Add internationalization to a project for translating a project across multiple languages. In this project, both Chinese and English are supported.
about.tailwind_desc: Use TailwindCSS to help us with designing a beautiful modern application.
about.upload_desc: Upload the file to the server, add the upload progress, and visually display the upload progress in the form of progress bar. even cover how to implement a fallback solution in case drag n drop is not available.
about.music_desc: Implement basic features such as playing/pausing, scrubbing and displaying the current duration. Make the rest of the site functional by allowing users to submit comments, browse music, and sort data.
about.dark_desc: Don’t want to be one of those websites that blinds people when they open it on their phone at 2am? So this site has a dark mode.
about.auth_desc: Users will be able to login immediately after registering for an account.
about.transition_desc: Add transitions and animations to add some sparkle to the app and breathe life into any app. Improve the user experience by providing feedback to the user about their actions.
about.validation_desc: We will perform form validation to prevent invalid data from being submitted.
about.deploy_desc: Deploy to production.  Deploy our app to Vercel with a single command! Quick and easy.
about.efficiency_desc: Auto-Registering Global Components. For example, the option to internationalize.
about.local_desc: Store the selected language and dark mode locally, So that the user's next visit is still the previous system Settings.
about.loading_desc: The home song list scrolls to the bottom to load more data.
about.firebase_desc: Uploading files to Firebase, It's vital we validate files with Firebase.
